svg.title: Mockup 02: Readiness before an event (organiser, crew, superadmin)
svg.text: 02 · Readiness: is this event ready, and if not, what do I fix? (organiser, crew, superadmin)
Use case: the day before doors, an event admin opens Readiness. U3, U4, U5, L1, L2; grid as design amendment 3 (card size: 3 columns at 1280 px).

g.text: 2 blockers before doors on Sat 21 Nov at 12:00 · Readiness

Blockers stop Go live; an event admin may override with a reason (audited).

svg.text: The summary and the crew actions
Counts by state, the time to doors, Recheck now
and Send digest now. The shell's red band appears
only in the last 24 hours when a blocker is open
Blockers are few (U4)
No screen paired, the hostname not verified, no
backup in 24 h, the platform not on the event's
release, the laptop not checked. They stop Go live
unless overridden with a reason.
One sentence and its fix (L1)
Each card says what is wrong in plain words and
links to the page that fixes it. Order is stable: a
state change never moves a card.
The platform group (U3)
Organisers see it read-only with whom to ask; the
superadmin acts on it (mockup 04).
A grid that scales
Cards are 18 rem minimum: 3 columns at 1280 px,
5 at 1920 px, one on a phone. Each module
answers its own checks (contract, additive).
